name: PT Temas Tbk.
summary: PT Temas Tbk. engages in the transportation activities in Indonesia and internationally. It operates in two segments, Shipping and Stevedoring. The company offers cargo handling and seaport services, such as stevedoring and cargodoring services, receiving and shipping containers, rental of loading and, discharging equipment, warehousing and logistics distribution, general cargo handling, and trucking; shipping solution; and depot solutions, including inspection, repair and cleaning, stuffing and stripping, precool and preset, storage, warehousing, empty container trucking, and handling and rental heavy lift.
